newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EMU major headache for social security-Lamfalussy.
newsitem.headline: EMU major headache for social security-Lamfalussy.

text.p: The task of adapting the social security systems of European Union governments to a single currency could become a major problem, Alexandre Lamfalussy, president of the European Monetary Institute, said on Wednesday.
"I just shudder at the task of switching over the social security systems," Lamfalussy told a monetary sub-committee of the European Parliament.
"It could become a major problem of the changeover scenario."

With public sector spending accounting for almost half of Gross Domestic Product in most EU countries, the EMI chief said the time needed for governments to switch their operations into the new common currency was not to be underestimated.
